ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed toward low-intensity values (black) with a sparse distribution of high-intensity white pixels (approx. 15% coverage).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-gray to black base. High-contrast white circular rings and punctate spots are clustered predominantly on the lateral distal regions and scattered across the central fluke surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate 50-degree interior angle and significant bounding-box depth relative to the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Primary edge is relatively smooth with low-amplitude undulations. High-frequency, irregular pixel jaggedness is concentrated at the extreme distal tips where biological protrusions occur.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to a straight diagonal sweep toward the posterior-lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of white circular and ring-shaped pixel clusters (ranging from 5 to 20 pixels in diameter) distributed across both lobes, particularly dense on the right lobe's upper quadrant.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several short, horizontal high-contrast white linear disruptions visible on the right lobe near the mid-trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive stalked barnacle colonies (biological growths) creating irregular, high-relief geometric profiles at the distal tips of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Densely concentrated white 'salt-and-pepper' pixel speckling present at the base of the fluke where it meets the peduncle.
